posts.zh:
dsh-shortcuts 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Web UI 可自定义键盘快捷键：34 个预置功能（会话、视图、剪贴板、模型、静默权限切换、设置），一键录制自定义组合键，内置快捷键速查表与诊断面板。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-66b108ec2c04e83ed567.html
posts.en:
dsh-shortcuts is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the Web UI: 34 pre-registered features (sessions, views, clipboard, models, silent permission cycling, settings), one-click recording to bind your own, and a shortcut cheatsheet with built-in diagnostics.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-66b108ec2c04e83ed567.html
